heat.processing: expire old marks; apply the declared nonnegative integer amount once per legitimate attack phase and pool; append its units one at a time and test the threshold after every appended unit
heat.threshold_result: atomically consume exactly 8 marks and sum their two contributions into one unique burn dose
heat.overflow: on each threshold, consume exactly the actual 8 marks into one dose, then continue processing the still-unapplied units from this same paid application; retain the remainder with original source contributions and absolute expiry
heat.multiple_ignitions_from_large_declared_a: possible only for each full paid set of 8; each produces an independent 4-second dose, and same-family burn aggregation still takes maximum rather than stacking damage

burn.dot_aggregation: maximum potency among unexpired burn doses
burn.vulnerability_aggregation: maximum vulnerability among unexpired burn doses, independently of damage potency
burn.direct_application: only sources whose branch or trap payload explicitly declares a direct 4-second burn may bypass heat

poison.lifetime: until this health pool truly terminates or an explicitly designed cleansing operation removes it
poison.qualified_sources: built enabled tower with a legitimate ready attack, or a trap that commits one valid charge
poison.aggregate_storage: sum nonnegative potency-weighted load; do not allocate one permanent object for each accumulated unit
poison.target_defense_and_vulnerability: read current target values for each paid damage segment

contagion.copies: only the explicit newly added dose, never the recipient's historical total load
contagion.target_fanout: declared by branch or trap; every new qualified primary dose remains eligible

ticket_budgets.budget_rule: the source load plus all issued tickets is the full budget of this original application; spending a ticket moves its reserved load, never creates extra load
ticket_budgets.ticket_deadline: original primary application time + 4 seconds; source upgrade, transfer and retarget do not refresh it
ticket_budgets.targets: other legal manifested independent pools within 1.5 tiles; each dose may reach each recipient at most once
ticket_budgets.unspent_ticket: expires unused; do not grant it back as source load or spend it after carrier terminal
ticket_budgets.source_disabled: already attached tickets retain only their original lifetime
ticket_budgets.fission: partition unspent tickets exactly once across child carriers; do not give each child a full set

delayed_once_dose_budget.extra_load: finite amount declared and reserved by the original dose; not a percentage of current total q
delayed_once_dose_budget.aggregation: young buckets with due times; matured load merges into the ordinary aggregate and the pending budget is retired
delayed_once_dose_budget.fission: partition both already applied q and all unpaid maturation load; preserve absolute due times and the once-only flag
delayed_once_dose_budget.full_explicit_poison_cleanse: must clear the affected pending budget as well as its current load unless that monster contract explicitly distinguishes the two

poison.fission: partition load and its potency contribution exactly; fractional quantities or fixed-point remainder distribution must conserve the sum

death_transfer.source_scope: only load tagged at application as inheritable by this actual source instance; do not sweep other poison towers or pre-upgrade load
death_transfer.trigger: true terminal of a poisoned pool; actor removal by fission is not death
death_transfer.amount: half of the remaining eligible source-owned load is a single total transfer budget, split equally across up to two valid recipients
death_transfer.failed_destination: unused transfer budget is lost; no global fallback or reward

frost.explicit_shatter_push: must first end freeze, then resolve the declared displacement; it does not extend hard-control allowance
frost.failed_attempt: consume the attempted meter and start the shared attempt cooldown
frost.during_hard_control_or_immunity: clear freeze reserve; legal cold hits give soft cold trace rather than banked freeze stacks
frost.brittle: read pre-consumption chill snapshot; existing frost freeze or cold trace can qualify; new marks are consumed only by a later attack batch
frost.slow_aggregation: maximum of active slow families, not a product
frost.application_sampling: no extra global target interval; each source uses its explicitly declared application_interval_s for maintained emissions, while each explicitly paid projectile or wave phase can apply once per independent pool
frost.freeze_request_source: the eligible source that submits the current threshold request supplies its explicitly purchased freeze duration; do not borrow the best rank from another source
frost.threshold_request_order: stable world time, source id, attack id and phase order; one shared full threshold is consumed atomically by at most one request
frost.paid_multiwave_example: T03.A2 two explicit cold waves 0.7 seconds apart may each add chill; the second wave is not swallowed by a global target gate

curse.full_stack_refresh: replace the oldest source mark with the actual new mark; do not refresh all older deadlines
curse.trigger: threshold reached or retained, cooldown complete, and a new legal curse application occurs
curse.randomization: deterministic seeded draw derived from persistent encounter seed and immutable attack_id
curse.decision_point: the actual attack commit immediately before issuing damaging payload or launching projectiles
curse.failure_behavior: cancel this uncommitted attack payload and enter its usual recovery/cooldown; retain ordinary movement
curse.multihit_attack: one decision covers all subordinate hits of the same attack_id
curse.canceled_before_commit: does not consume a nonexistent attack draw
curse.applies_to: monster direct damaging attacks explicitly admitted to the attack system
curse.base_reduction_snapshot: outgoing attack amount is determined at attack commit; later curse changes do not rewrite issued attacks

electric.charged_predicate: meter_amount > 0 on a currently legal manifested hostile independent health pool
electric.source_overload_base_override: must be explicit in the source branch or trap payload
electric.mixed_source_overload_base: sum contribution of exactly the five charge_units consumed by this wave; split fractional lots proportionally
can_add_charge: positive actual damage with element=electric, including primary, appliance contact, one-hop bounce and overload
an explicitly declared independent paid charging pulse or trap application even when it is not a damaging packet
cannot_add_charge: non-electric damage merely using the spiritual defense channel
missed, blocked, canceled or zero-actual-damage electric packets without an explicitly separate paid charge payload
duplicate receipts of an already committed electric impact
electric.threshold_state: at most one queued ready request per pool reserves exactly five live charge_units; surplus remains banked with original absolute expiry
electric.full_ready_new_hits: append the actual new charge_units and its own expiry even while a request is ready; never discard paid overflow and never refresh older lots
electric.independent_appliance_pulse: explicit purchased primary emission; same source/attack phase/pool dedupe across overlapping appliance sensing domains
electric.meter_amount: sum of positive unexpired charge_units, including reserved and unreserved amounts
electric.primary_charge_application: a normal electric impact applies its explicitly declared charge_units once, not that amount plus a second generic on-electric-hit unit
electric.expiry_order: remove lots with expires_at <= current world time before threshold checks and wave snapshots
electric.storage: aggregate compatible finite-lived lots by expiry and potency/ownership; no per-frame immortal token allocation

feedback.formula: feedback_charge_units_i = min(1, 2 / m), where m is the number of independent pools taking positive actual damage in this wave
feedback.dead_recipient: include its positive damage in m; attach its assigned charge before terminal cleanup, then discard all status at true terminal; no dead-pool wave
feedback.no_round_up: retain fractional values in simulation; UI rounding never changes threshold or conservation
feedback.conservation: each wave consumes 5 and returns at most 2 charge_units; without fresh external primary/contact/trap input, total live charge strictly falls by at least 3 per wave
feedback.energy_conservation: each wave consumes potency contribution D and returns at most 2/5 * 0.75 * D = 0.3D; no feedback can upgrade old source potency

stages: apply permanent rule facts to base defense
take strongest live generic break for this channel
resolve raw packet through its one defense channel

rule_cooperation_source.condition: a real main-rule success for that root while the broadcaster is active; recipients must currently be in its valid sound domain

damage.primary_dedupe: one legitimate attack phase per independent health_pool_id
named_paid_exceptions: a previously reserved poison maturity budget
electric_feedback_conservation: a positive electric impact can add its declared finite charge budget and queue later overloads
damage.exception_rule: electric overload chains may have multiple waves and no hop-count cap; every wave consumes five real live charge_units and returns at most two. All other ordinary damage-on-hit recursion remains prohibited.
damage.same_batch_death: resolve the full already-committed hit batch before fission or terminal settlement
damage.secondary_scope: ordinary on-hit and ordinary secondary procs only; named electric_feedback_conservation explicitly overrides the charge/overload recursion ban
damage.electric_hit_charge_order: resolve the legitimate electric damage packet, apply its one declared charge grant, queue threshold requests after the current atomic batch; no recursive same-call-stack overload

zone_toll.source_tower_cell_damage: explicit per branch; may exceed trap damage
zone_toll.deadline_update: ordinary toll writes hit_time + 2; a genuine phase-event toll ignores prior deadlines exactly once for that event and rewrites every actually charged cell to arrival_time + 2
zone_toll.overlapping_same_family: evaluate each currently legal source packet against this target current channel defense, source penetration and vulnerability; choose the greatest resolved damage and settle exactly that one base toll
zone_toll.overlapping_different_families: only if the design explicitly declares them distinct; source IDs alone do not create a new family
zone_toll.spatial_model: half-open fixed world cells; count positive-length segment intersections, not zero-length corner touches
zone_toll.movement_reference: one canonical combat reference trajectory per health pool; body width and shared body-part count do not multiply tolls
zone_toll.continuous_resolution: trace the real path in time order and check the cell, field existence, height and deadline at each crossing
zone_toll.discontinuous_resolution: for true_teleport, shadow_jump and mirror_transfer, trace the straight audit segment between actual committed departure and arrival; use the union of positive-length segment cells and the actual departure/arrival half-open cells, deduplicated; settle each active valid damage cell once. This deliberately represents phase punishment, not a physical ground path
zone_toll.stationary_resolution: while inside an active legal cell, one toll can recur when its existing deadline expires
zone_toll.same_cell_teleport: a genuine nonzero phase displacement within one valid damage cell pays that cell once and refreshes its deadline; a zero-displacement/canceled proposal is not a phase toll event
zone_toll.fission: copy all unexpired parent cell deadlines to each new pool, without cloning already committed damage
zone_toll.late_field_or_rebuild: cannot reset an existing ledger entry; a newly covered cell without an entry can deliver its normal first toll

test_example.assumption: zero relevant defense/vulnerability; four real active legal floor cells, one winning packet per cell

zone_toll.equal_resolved_damage_tiebreak: stable source ID, then attack and phase ID; never settle all tied sources
zone_toll.selection_and_commit: choose without dealing candidate damage or consuming candidate on-hit receipts; commit one winner and one shared pool/cell/family deadline
zone_toll.independent_declared_effects: a source explicitly scheduled status pulse, qualified residence reward or other separately paid sibling ability is tested by its own source contract even when another source wins the base toll; this grants no second base toll and no recursion

a real hostile independent health pool
phase_contract.audit_geometry: straight departure-to-arrival segment in store coordinates; not shortest navigable path, not mirror graph path, not Euclidean distance divided by cell size
phase_contract.cell_intersection: union of positive-length audit-segment intersections, actual departure half-open cell, and actual arrival half-open cell; deduplicate. Intermediate corner-only touches do not count; an actual endpoint on a boundary belongs to its own half-open cell and is included once
phase_contract.height: this explicitly phase-aware toll audits projected transition position independently of the nonexistent intermediate travel height; ordinary continuous high-air movement remains subject to actual field height
phase_contract.solid_occupancy: only actual active damage domains on legal walkable floor contribute; wall/shelf/cabinet volume and uncovered gaps produce no damage cell
phase_contract.wall_between_endpoints: does not stop the symbolic audit segment, but the wall itself never counts as a zone; no ordinary projectile, trap or DOT gains wall penetration
phase_contract.field_snapshot_time: after legal arrival is committed and any explicitly phase-aware charged-zone activation is committed, before the arriving pool starts a new attack
phase_contract.damage_formula: sum of one winning legal resolved packet for each distinct valid covered cell; if all cells have identical raw D and defense, raw total = number_of_cells * D
phase_contract.refresh: after atomic phase toll settlement, all actually charged cells receive arrival_world_time + cell_period_s; all unaffected cells retain their previous deadlines
phase_contract.repeat_delivery_of_same_event: zero new damage and no deadline refresh
phase_contract.another_real_phase_before_two_seconds: new event can pay the same effective cells again and refresh them once; this is the deliberate displacement penalty
phase_contract.simultaneous_ordinary_arrival_toll: absorbed into this cell phase packet; do not pay both phase and ordinary arrival for the same cell in the same event
phase_contract.endpoint_specialization: an explicitly purchased stronger arrival or phase-cell packet competes as a replacement for that cell; never add both ordinary and replacement base tolls
forbidden_implied_interactions: appliance contact crossings in the absent middle
ordinary collision or blocking along the audit segment
phase_contract.canceled_or_preview_only_move: no toll, no cooldown refresh, no trap charge debit and no valid-phase receipt; reject zero displacement before writing any receipt
phase_contract.multiple_real_legs: each separately committed phase event audits its own real endpoints; replaying a rendering frame is not another leg
phase_contract.same_batch_terminal: settle this entire already-committed toll batch before fission/terminal rules; no split can erase the paid line
phase_contract.phase_exit_targetability: phase producers must commit a legal manifested exit window; this tax resolves at the exit before new attack work, not against an invented mid-travel actor

phase_aware_trap_activation.condition: an armed R09 has a valid paid charge and the real phase audit intersects at least one legal cell of its actual floor footprint
phase_aware_trap_activation.debit: at most one charge per trap instance and phase_event_id
phase_aware_trap_activation.activation: commit the explicit eight-second R09 field before the same event selects winning cells
phase_aware_trap_activation.already_active: do not debit or restart its field merely because another phase arrives
phase_aware_trap_activation.scope: this is an explicit phase-aware zone source exception, not a rule for generic floor traps
phase_aware_trap_activation.extra_branch_effects: R09 A may evaluate its own paid traversal bonus for at least two distinct actually charged cells inside its field, using its shared two-second bonus cooldown; R09 B residence only uses real elapsed presence

persistent_field.damage_timing: pay the same active world-time interval regardless of render frame rate
persistent_field.motion_resolution: evaluate actual presence in the field over time; do not assign a full residence tick merely for crossing between sampled positions
persistent_field.finite_field_snapshot: an explicitly launched independent finite field keeps only its originally declared duration and payload
persistent_field.balance: minimum circle radius is one tile; concentration, duty cycle, status cadence and target residence trade for DPS, never an unusably small radius inside a fixture
persistent_field.phase_endpoint_residence: only time actually spent at legal departure or arrival positions counts; the symbolic phase-audit middle contributes no residence

ready_request_payload: exactly five reserved live charge_units, possibly split across fractional lots
their unchanged source potency contributions and absolute expiry
original valid ready time and stable request ID
atomic_wave_steps: expire due charge lots and invalidate affected reservations; if at least five other live units remain, create a fresh request at current time rather than preserving invalid queue priority
pick the oldest eligible seed with five actually reserved live charge_units
snapshot the currently legal charged-pool and powered-appliance spatial graph before seed consumption
visit the entire connected component containing the seed; each independent pool and each appliance_id is a unique node
for every pool recipient snapshot its one-edge charged-pool neighborhood N including itself and its directly adjacent appliance count E
consume exactly five seed charge_units and sum their potency contributions into effective D; preserve unreserved overflow
commit one spiritual electric packet D*(N_i+E_i) to each eligible pool in the component, using the same wave snapshot
count m distinct pools taking positive actual damage; each gets min(1,2/m) new charge_units with source D=0.75*wave_D and expiry current_time+8
finish the whole wave batch and true terminal/fission handling; no zero-health pool emits a new wave
keep valid existing requests; create fresh FIFO requests for other surviving pools now holding at least five units, including a seed whose overflow plus feedback is still full
electric_network.count_identity: independent health_pool_id, never collider parts or shared root IDs
electric_network.N_i: one plus the number of directly adjacent legal charged independent pool nodes at this wave snapshot; includes recipient itself even though seed charge will be consumed next
electric_network.E_i: number of distinct directly adjacent enabled actually powered registered appliance nodes; distant component devices may relay but do not inflate this local coefficient
electric_network.target_set: all legal charged independent health pools in the seed spatial connected component, including remote pools outside the seed radius reached through any number of valid pool/device edges
electric_network.temporary_untargetability: defer while keeping original mark expiry; no untargetable new area hits, and no frozen queue lifetime
cancel_ready_when: expiry leaves fewer than the reserved five valid units
genuine fission replaces the parent pool; partition all real quantity/contributions and cancel parent request
electric_network.moving_between_waves: recompute all current edges, device power, charge presence and local multipliers for every wave; no stale component snapshots
electric_network.inherited_fission_ready: partition charge quantities, potency and absolute deadlines; never copy a reservation; a surviving child with an actual five units creates a new ready request

bounce.recipients: one other currently charged legal independent pool; nearest valid distance then stable identity
bounce.source_overload_base: the originating primary/contact source declared D, multiplied by 0.75 for this secondary paid bounce
bounce.aoe_budget: one ordinary extra arc for the entire multi-target phase, not one arc per primary recipient; simultaneous multi-appliance induction domains are one source phase
bounce.selection: after this phase primary packets and their charge grants, examine legal direct pool-pool pairs from actual primary impact positions; choose the nearest pair, then stable primary/recipient IDs; never count a device relay as an ordinary one-hop bounce
bounce.appliance_contact_budget: each genuinely separate appliance entry damage event has one phase budget; duplicate entry callbacks share it
bounce.trigger_scope: only the explicitly allowed one-hop bounce after an eligible normal electric primary or actual appliance contact; overload packets never spawn this extra bounce
bounce.charge_application: one positive bounce damage packet grants exactly one charge unit; it does not copy any historical source meter

appliance_contact.contact_domain: union of the real one-tile surface domain and explicitly bound valid copper-rail extensions for that one appliance
appliance_contact.true_entry_event_order: latch a genuine outside-to-inside movement entry; apply an explicitly paid entry-trap charge grant such as R16; if now charged, resolve one appliance contact damage and its one charge unit; then permit at most one bounce
appliance_contact.multiple_rail_parts: entering another part of the same appliance union is not a new entry; must first leave the entire union
appliance_contact.one_event_dedupe: health_pool_id + actual movement entry ID + appliance_id; no reactive electric damage can manufacture another movement ID
appliance_contact.phase_real_arrival_contact: the actual outside-to-inside departure/arrival membership change may qualify once if the actual committed destination is in the union; the imaginary middle never qualifies

outward_charge_transfer.mark_choice: earliest-expiring eligible native unreserved charge lots totaling one real charge_unit; split proportionally, preserve deadlines/potency, and move at most once
outward_charge_transfer.failure: if no legal uncharged recipient exists, move nothing and do not consume the transfer cooldown
outward_charge_transfer.sensing_distance_reference: registered real appliance footprint surface; copper rails do not relocate or expand this sensing radius
outward_charge_transfer.transferred_mark_tag: received_by_outward_transfer; ineligible for another outward transfer, while still contributing normally to charged state and overload
outward_charge_transfer.insufficient_native_charge: if eligible native unreserved amount is less than one, move nothing and do not consume cooldown

electric_network.reservation_policy: reserve earliest-expiring live units first, then stable application identity; split a lot only by exact proportional quantity and potency

charge_lot_contract.merge_only_when: expiry, source potency, attribution, transfer eligibility and reservation identity all match; merging does not change total quantity or contribution
charge_lot_contract.transfer: preserve original applied/expiry times, source potency and attribution; assign a deterministic child lot identity only to distinguish the transferred fraction
charge_lot_contract.feedback: new lot_id = wave_id + recipient_pool_id + feedback; applied=current wave time, expiry=applied+8, source_D=0.75*wave_D
charge_lot_contract.precision: reference fixtures use exact rational values; runtime uses sufficient precision and conservative comparisons without rounding charge gains upward

five_unit_consumption.at_ready_creation: sort unreserved positive live lots by charge_lot_contract.ordering; reserve quantities successively until exactly five units are assigned to this one request
five_unit_consumption.partial_last_lot: reserve needed q and q*source_D/5 contribution; leave remainder q and its proportional contribution with exactly the original deadline and source attributes
five_unit_consumption.while_waiting: the reservation remains attached to these exact amounts; new charge appends outside it and does not refresh, upgrade or replace old reserved amounts
five_unit_consumption.invalidated_reservation: remove expired/cleansed quantity, release every still-live reserved remainder to the ordinary pool, cancel the request, then create a new ready request only if at least five live units remain; ready_time becomes current world time
five_unit_consumption.at_wave: after checking all five reserved units are still live, consume them atomically and sum only their potency contributions into D
five_unit_consumption.surplus: retain every nonconsumed unit and unchanged deadline; if post-wave overflow plus feedback reaches five, create a new request with new priority at current time
five_unit_consumption.fission: cancel parent reservation; partition all real live quantity and contribution once among child pools while preserving deadlines; children create their own fresh requests if actually at threshold
five_unit_consumption.dedupe: consumption receipt is keyed by wave_id and ready_request_id; duplicate processing cannot remove another five or generate another feedback batch

chain_termination_proof.loose_upper_bound_on_remaining_waves: max(0, floor((Q_initial - 5) / 3) + 1), ignoring earlier losses from expiry, terminal cleanup and fragmentation
chain_termination_proof.new_external_energy: normal tower pulses, paid trap grants or a fresh valid appliance entry can extend the chain by supplying new charge; that is intended and is not free closed-loop recursion

identity_and_fission.already_active_timed_effects: inherit original deadlines; never extend duration merely because a new actor is created
